- Compliance asks: SOC 2 report, encryption-at-rest and in-transit, audit logs, and proof of key management.

- Security/InfoSec: Samantha Green (you)
- Legal: Laura Chen (you mentioned?)
- Procurement: procurement@acme-health.com (TBD lead)
- Economic/Business Buyer: Tom Rivera
- Technical Lead: (engineering contact TBD)

1) Kickoff meeting to go through the security questionnaire and scope - please share legal/procurement contacts and any internal timeline constraints.
2) We’ll circulate the Redwood security questionnaire (attached stub) and a draft SoW to speed review.
3) Confirm systems in scope (API endpoints, admin console, any on-prem connectors).

Suggested kickoff slots (PDT): Mon 8/31 10:00-11:00, Tue 9/1 09:00-10:00, or Wed 9/2 14:00-15:00 - please let me know what works.

Thanks - looking forward to aligning on scope and timeline.

Thanks Samantha - that’s helpful. A few clarifications to help the security team scope their review:

Systems in scope by default for hosted Redwood API deployment:
- Production API endpoints (ingest/response paths) - REQUIRED
- Customer admin/ops console (SaaS UI) - INCLUDED (we surface logs/usage there)
- Data stores managed by Redwood (blob storage, audit logs) - INCLUDED
- On-prem EHR connectors - EXCLUDED unless you adopt Redwood Private or request a connector deployment; we can scope that separately.

For contracts: we can start with a standard vendor DPA + SOC 2 evidence. If Laura prefers, I can send our SoW/contract template - attaching a Statement_of_Work_Draft.docx for review (draft).

Confirming kickoff: Mon 2026-08-31 10:00-11:00 PDT works for us - I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda to run through the questionnaire and evidence requests.

Agenda (15 min each):
- Introductions & scope confirmation
- Questionnaire walk-through (info needed from Acme security/legal)
- Evidence and timeline (SOC 2 report, encryption, KMS details, audit logs)
- Next steps & decision timeline

Thanks - I’ll loop Aditya (solutions engineering) into the invite for any technical deep-dive required.

Best,
